projects.title: AI-Powered Smart Agriculture Monitoring System
projects.description: A sensor-based monitoring system for agricultural environments, paired with a full technical breakdown and cost analysis using real Nigerian market component pricing (Jumia, Konga) to keep the build practical and locally sourceable.

projects.title: AI Voice and Facial Recognition Smart Security System
projects.description: A smart security concept combining voice and facial recognition, scoped with a detailed technical and cost breakdown sourced against the Nigerian retail market.

projects.title: Pipeline Leak Detection System
projects.description: A comparative fault-detection study for pipeline leaks, classifying pressure, flow, and acoustic sensor data using two approaches: a fuzzy logic system and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network.

projects.title: AskDept - Departmental RAG Assistant
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented generation assistant for departmental questions. The pipeline covers document loading, chunking via recursive character text splitting, embedding with sentence-transformers, and vector storage/retrieval through FAISS.
